lenses.name: Population
lenses.description: Residents per km² at the 2011 census: each district's population over its area, averaged over the districts the hex covers. Colours span the 2nd–98th percentile of hexes; values beyond are drawn at the end colours.

lenses.name: Urban
lenses.description: Share of each district's 2011 population living in statutory or census towns. Colours span the 2nd–98th percentile of hexes; values beyond are drawn at the end colours.

lenses.name: Literacy
lenses.description: Literates as a share of people aged 7 and over, per district, at the 2011 census. Colours span the 2nd–98th percentile of hexes; values beyond are drawn at the end colours.

lenses.name: Farm workers
lenses.description: Cultivators and agricultural labourers (main and marginal) as a share of all workers, per district, at the 2011 census. Colours span the 2nd–98th percentile of hexes; values beyond are drawn at the end colours.

lenses.name: Income per person
lenses.description: Per-capita Net State Domestic Product at current prices, 2022-23 (NSO state accounts, RBI handbook). Blank for states that have not published it. Colours span the 2nd–98th percentile of hexes; values beyond are drawn at the end colours.
lenses.note: State-wide values: every hex of a state has the same colour.

lenses.name: Earthquakes
lenses.description: Earthquakes of magnitude 5.5 or more since 1900 (USGS catalogue) with an epicentre within 50 km of the hex centre. Colours span the 2nd–98th percentile of hexes; values beyond are drawn at the end colours.
lenses.note: Early-20th-century records are incomplete; zero means none recorded, not no risk.

lenses.name: Strongest quake
lenses.description: The largest magnitude among M5.5+ earthquakes since 1900 within 50 km of the hex centre (USGS catalogue). Blank where none was recorded.

lenses.name: Forest
lenses.description: Share of the hex's land covered by trees (ESA WorldCover 2021). Colours span the 2nd–98th percentile of hexes; values beyond are drawn at the end colours.

lenses.name: Farmland
lenses.description: Share of the hex's land that is cropland (ESA WorldCover 2021). WorldCover has no separate pasture class; grazed steppe counts as grassland. Colours span the 2nd–98th percentile of hexes; values beyond are drawn at the end colours.

lenses.name: Built-up
lenses.description: Share of the hex's land that is built-up (ESA WorldCover 2021): buildings, roads and other sealed surfaces. Colours span the 2nd–98th percentile of hexes; values beyond are drawn at the end colours.
